title: MENA Weekly Round-Up: Oman Advances Solar Manufacturing Investments
summary: The Oman Investment Authority (OIA) announced the completion of seven projects with a combined investment of OMR 1.6 billion (~$4.17 billion) across the energy, manufacturing, and services sectors. The projects include the United Solar Polysilicon plant in Sohar Free Zone, developed with an investment of OMR 668 million (~$1.74 billion).

direction_reasons: polysilicon is an input cost and is moving up
watch_next: polysilicon over the next few weeks
WAAREEENER.why_it_matters: This reaches the company indirectly via its commodity exposure to polysilicon. The parts of the business most likely touched are input cost. Classified as other.
